`peerjs.min.js` is PeerJS 1.5.4 (MIT, (c) 2015 Michelle Bu and Eric Zhang), vendored so the app works offline.

`qrcode.min.js` is qrcode-generator 1.4.4 (MIT, (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase), minified, used to draw the room QR code on the device. "QR Code" is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.

`dice3d.js` is the studio-quality 3D dice: our own code (`tools/dice3d/dice3d.js`) bundled with three.js r187 (MIT, (c) 2010-2025 three.js authors), built with `tools/build-dice3d.mjs`. three.js licence: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/LICENSE
